title: Room/Seat 关闭的总期限、返回码与残留 owner 未被具体承接
origin: IF10/IF11 frozen independently; exact caller return-code and reference-clearing detail added after freeze
candidate_location: authorities F20/P17/P19; P00-v3 asset table close.ts/seat-runtime.ts; C14.2/C33.2
source_fact: Room waits at most8000ms then process.exit(0). Seat default close waits10000ms before terminate; it can wait a further5000ms after kill, plus identity/kill-command time. Room awaits Promise<number> but never tests its returned number, deletes the seat and logs closed. PersistentCodexSeat clears child/thread references after any returned close result, including refused/timeout, then writes failed state.
author_claim: Existing policy requires unknown-identity/residual tests, non-adoption of whole Room, and generic old-writer fencing. These are acknowledged but do not state this cross-layer deadline or consume the numeric result at this actual caller.
impact: A still-live child may outlast the host deadline. A resolved nonzero code need not mean the child or its descendants exited. This affects reuse of selected close.ts/seat-runtime.ts and owner hand-off; it is not a request to adopt or repair the whole legacy Room product now. No orphan was actually created in this audit.
required_change: Add explicit source/caller/failure rows and separate graceful exit, attempted kill, refused kill, unknown residual, host forced exit and ownership quarantine. State which selected worker host owns the full deadline and retains uncertain identity; do not release/reassign home or writer merely because close resolved. Keep Room non-adoption explicit.
owner: WP00 evidence correction; WP03/T32.L,T52.L,T63.L before selected process lifecycle reuse
first_safe_case: Fake clock + mocked Seat/child handles: 8s host deadline vs10s grace; close resolves124/125; kill returns but exited promise stays pending. Assert no successful-close label or owner-release/replacement receipt. No real provider, PID kill or daemon.
